title: Sumac Chicken, Potato & Cauliflower
description: Chicken thighs marinated in sumac, spices and yogurt, roasted on a tray with crushed new potatoes and cauliflower.
ingredients: handful of coriander leaves, roughly chopped
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Simmer potatoes in boiling water for 15 minutes.
Mix sumac, chilli, thyme, cumin, cinnamon, tomato purée, red wine vinegar and 1 tbsp yogurt in a large bowl. Add chicken; turn to coat fully.
Drain potatoes; spray a deep baking tray; add potatoes and crush with a potato masher (not fully, just burst and flatten).
Place marinated chicken in gaps between potatoes. Spray generously. Roast on top shelf for 20 minutes.
Remove; stir potatoes and chicken; add cauliflower; spray again; season. Roast on top shelf for 10 more minutes.
Drizzle over remaining yogurt; sprinkle with chopped coriander. Serve immediately.
notes: Add extra vegetables for the last 10 minutes — green beans, broccoli or courgettes work well.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
